description.en: Cannot leave the field; will deploy at the target location with the current HP
description.zh: 不退场，以当前血量在目标位置部署

description.en: Replenishes ammo for other Operators' ammo-type skills; an ammo-type skill can only be replenished up to its max ammo capacity during a single activation of that skill
description.zh: 为其他人的弹药类技能补充弹药。单次弹药类技能的持续时间内，最多被补充该次技能所装有弹药数量上限的弹药

description.en: Reduces Physical and Arts damage taken from aerial units by a certain percentage (does not stack with Sanctuary effects of the same name, highest value applies)
description.zh: 受到来自空中的物理和法术伤害降低相应比例（同名效果取最高）

description.en: When selecting a deployed Operator, can activate extra effects when certain conditions are fulfilled
description.zh: 选中在场干员后，可以通过一定条件激活的额外效果

description.en: Cannot be blocked and moves towards the target's position
description.zh: 无法被阻挡并向目标位置移动

description.en: Absorbs a certain amount of damage.
description.zh: 可以吸收一定数值的伤害

description.en: Increases stats proportionally based on lost HP, reaching the maximum bonus once a certain percentage has been lost (only the strongest effect of this type applies)
description.zh: 根据已损失的生命值获得相应比例的属性加成，损失一定比例时达最大加成（同类属性取最高）

description.en: When the corresponding Tied unit is no longer on the battlefield, this unit's skill immediately ends, SP is set to 0, and SP can no longer be gained
description.zh: 绑定对象不在场时技能强制结束，清空所有技力且无法回复技力

description.en: <$ba.stun>Stun</>, <$ba.cold>Cold</>, and <$ba.frozen>Frozen</> durations halved; <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</> loses 1 stack every 5s (does not stack with the same effect)
description.zh: <$ba.stun>晕眩</>、<$ba.cold>寒冷</>、<$ba.frozen>冻结</>、<$ba.fear>恐惧</>、<$ba.attract>诱导</>等异常状态的持续时间减半；<$ba.palsy>麻痹</>等状态每5秒流失1层（同名效果不叠加）

description.en: Prevents being targeted by normal enemy attacks if the unit is not blocking (but will still take Splash damage)
description.zh: 不阻挡时不成为敌方普通攻击的目标（无法躲避溅射类攻击）

description.en: Stops attacking for a period of time, then attempts to activate skill; interruptions during this period will stop the chant
description.zh: 停止攻击一段时间后尝试开启技能，期间被打断则中止

description.en: Can continue recovering SP after reaching the maximum. When SP reaches double the maximum, enters Charged state. Skills have additional effects when activated in Charged state (All SP will be consumed whenever the skill is activated)
description.zh: 技力达到上限可继续回复，回复至上限2倍时进入蓄力状态，此时开启技能会触发额外效果（任何时候开启均消耗全部技力）

description.en: Reduces ASPD by 30 and causes subsequent applications of the Cold status during the debuff duration to inflict <$ba.frozen>Frozen</>
description.zh: 攻击速度下降30，如果在持续时间内再次受到寒冷效果则会变为<$ba.frozen>冻结</>

description.en: DP can drop below the DP Lower Limit; when DP is below 0, natural DP regeneration rate -50%
description.zh: 部署费用可降低至部署费用下限；部署费用小于0时部署费用自然回复速度-50%

description.en: Includes <$ba.stun>Stun</>, <$ba.cold>Cold</>, <$ba.frozen>Freeze</>, etc.
description.zh: 包括<$ba.stun>晕眩</>、<$ba.cold>寒冷</>、<$ba.frozen>冻结</>等

description.en: Reduces incoming damage by a fixed amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)
description.zh: 受到的伤害降低一定数值（同名效果取最高）

description.en: After Necrosis reaches 1000, the affected unit cannot use skills for 15 seconds and every second loses 1 SP and takes 100 Arts damage
description.zh: 凋亡损伤累计至1000时，15秒内无法开启技能，每秒损失1点技力并受到100点法术伤害

description.en: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), inflicting 50%<$ba.weaken>Enfeeble</> that gradually recovers, and dealing 800 Elemental Damage per second. 15s cooldown.
description.zh: 累计满时爆发（普通、精英敌人1000点、领袖2000点累计值），使敌人附加50%<$ba.weaken>虚弱</>但期间逐渐恢复，每秒受到800点元素伤害。15秒冷却

description.en: After Burn reaches 1000, the affected unit has its RES reduced by 20 for 10 seconds and takes 1200 Arts damage
description.zh: 灼燃损伤累计至1000时，10秒内降低20法术抗性并受到1200点法术伤害

description.en: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 7000 Elemental Damage and temporarily inflicting -20 RES. 10s cooldown.
description.zh: 累计满时爆发（普通、精英敌人1000点、领袖2000点累计值），敌人立即受到7000点元素伤害且期间法术抗性-20。10秒冷却

description.en: Includes <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</>, <$ba.dt.erosion>Corrosion</>, <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</>, and <$ba.dt.apoptosis>Necrosis</>
description.zh: 包括<$ba.dt.neural>神经损伤</>、<$ba.dt.erosion>侵蚀损伤</>、<$ba.dt.burning>灼燃损伤</>、<$ba.dt.apoptosis>凋亡损伤</>、<$ba.dt.rampage>狂躁损伤</>

description.en: After Corrosion reaches 1000, the affected unit has its DEF permanently reduced by 100 and takes 800 Physical damage
description.zh: 侵蚀损伤累计至1000时，永久降低100点防御力并受到800点物理伤害

description.en: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 5000 Elemental Damage and permanently reducing DEF by 120 (stacks). 8s cooldown.
description.zh: 累计满时爆发（普通、精英敌人1000点、领袖2000点累计值），敌人立即受到5000点元素伤害且永久降低120点防御力（可叠加）。8秒冷却

description.en: After Nervous Impairment reaches 1000, the affected unit takes 1000 True damage and is <$ba.stun>Stunned</> for 10s
description.zh: 神经损伤累计至1000时，受到1000点真实伤害并<$ba.stun>晕眩</>10秒

description.en: Explodes when at max (1000 for Normal and Elite, 2000 for Leaders), dealing 6000 Elemental Damage and inflicting 3 stacks of <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</>. 10s cooldown.
description.zh: 累计满时爆发（普通、精英敌人1000点、领袖2000点累计值），敌人立即受到6000点元素伤害且获得3层<$ba.palsy>麻痹</>。10秒冷却

description.en: When Manic Damage reaches 1000, grants ASPD +50 for 15 seconds, but takes 100 True damage per second (increases by 50 each time the unit attacks, up to 600)
description.zh: 狂躁损伤累计至1000时，15秒内攻击速度+50，但每秒受到100点真实伤害（每次攻击时提升50，最多600）

description.en: Movement Speed reduced, cannot be blocked, dies after 10s, restores SP to the attacker when defeated.
description.zh: 移速下降且无法被阻挡，10秒后自然死亡，被击杀后使击杀者回复数点技力

description.en: Amplifies all Elemental Damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)
description.zh: 受到的元素伤害提升相应比例（同名效果取最高）

description.en: Absorbs a certain amount of <$ba.dt.element>Elemental Injury</>.
description.zh: 可以吸收一定数值的<$ba.dt.element>元素损伤</>

description.en: Cannot be blocked and runs off uncontrollably
description.zh: 无法被阻挡并四散逃跑

description.en: Once Fever reaches 450, whenever any <$ba.mujica>Ave Mujica</> member's skill is manually activated, all <$ba.mujica>Ave Mujica</> members on the field will keep their current skill activated for 20s
description.zh: Fever累计至450点时，任意一位<$ba.mujica>Ave Mujica</>成员手动触发技能后，在场所有<$ba.mujica>Ave Mujica</>成员20秒内会持续释放当前技能

description.en: Cannot be blocked or attacked by melee attacks
description.zh: 无法被阻挡或近战攻击

description.en: Amplifies all Physical, Arts, and True damage taken by the corresponding amount (only the strongest effect of this type applies)
description.zh: 受到的物理、法术、真实伤害提升相应比例（同名效果取最高）

description.en: Unable to move, attack, or use skills (inflicted through the <$ba.cold>Cold</> status); When enemies are frozen, RES -15
description.zh: 无法移动、攻击及使用技能（通过<$ba.cold>寒冷</>触发）；敌方被冻结时，法术抗性-15

description.en: The target becomes a ground unit and cannot Move; forces certain Low-Altitude Hovering enemies to fall; duration halved against units with Weight greater than 3

description.zh: 造成的法术伤害提升（同名效果取最高）

description.zh: 造成物理或法术伤害时，根据目标防御力和法术抗性变更伤害类型
